meta.title: Dsh bot
meta.description: Brings a long-lived multi-Bot team into DSH: one sidebar row, the full team UI embedded in the panel with no extra window. Each Bot has its own thread, avatar and skin; a new Bot can load capability packs (team, helpers, memory, schedules, files, shell) and see the DSH plugins you already installed, and can use a custom model or the model library DSH already configured.
